Bedford School Finder

Your elementary, middle and high school today and under each of Bedford County Public Schools' four Round 2 working options for 2027-28.

Drafts for comment · not final

Example spot

"Aligned" and "small splits kept" are the two middle/high versions the District is weighing for each option. Students already in middle or high school can finish where they are; only new 6th and 9th graders would follow a new line. Rising 5th graders who would be rezoned finish grade 5 at their current school, and current transfer students stay through grade 5.

Every option on one page

Lines are the county's main roads. The maps move together. Click any of them to choose a spot; the red dot marks it on all five.

Zone data captured on 4 November 2026 from the District's public tool, Bedford Round 2 Proposed Attendance Zones (Demographic Analytics Advisors for Bedford County Public Schools, 2 November 2026). Addresses and roads: Bedford County GIS open data (NG911 address points and road centerlines). Zone outlines are lightly simplified, so a home within a few yards of a line may read wrong here; confirm it with the official tool, where you can also send the District a comment. This finder is unofficial.
